summary: Phase 1C-b (centralized Rate Plans + immutable commercial snapshot) verified end-to-end over live HTTP against http://localhost:3001/api/v1 as admin@stayos.local. 27 pytest cases across 2 new files: rate plan CRUD + validation (mealPlan enum, code regex, duplicate code 409, single-default 409), applicability upsert/list/delete + money-string validation, daily-rate override CRUD, PRICED snapshot math (5000x2 + 1500x1x2 = 13000.00), policies resolution, DAILY_OVERRIDE vs BASE_RATE per night (11500.00), default-plan fallback when ratePlanId omitted, UNPRICED + NO_APPLICABLE_RATE_PLAN with no fabricated totals, PENDING deferral -> confirm freeze, snapshot immutability (across re-reads, reservation PATCH, cancel), and transactional rollback for inapplicable/INACTIVE/unknown rate plans (reservation count unchanged). ALL 27 PASS. No inventory/concurrency suites were run.

minor.issue: extraChildCharge is accepted/persisted on rate-plan applicability but is NEVER used by rate-resolver.service.ts (child charges are delegated entirely to ChildPricingService / property guest-pricing policy). With extraChildCharge='700.00', childAges=[7] and NO property guest-pricing policy configured (GET /rates/guest-pricing-policy returns data:null), snapshot totals.child = '0.00'. Either wire extraChildCharge into resolution or drop/deprecate the field so operators are not misled.

Occupancy/date edits after CONFIRMED do NOT re-price and (correctly per 1C-b immutability) leave the snapshot untouched, so the snapshot can go stale: reservation.adults changed 2 -> 3 while rateSnapshot.occupancy.adults stayed 2 and extraAdult stayed 0.00. Acceptable for 1C-b, but a re-price/snapshot-version path (or blocking commercial-impacting edits) is needed before billing consumes the snapshot.

action_items: Decide on extraChildCharge: wire into RateResolverService or remove from UpsertRatePlanRoomTypeDto (currently a silently ignored money field).
Plan a re-pricing / snapshot-version strategy for post-confirmation occupancy or date changes (snapshot currently becomes stale by design).
critical_code_review_comments: rate-resolver.service.ts uses Number()/Math.round for money via strToCents; safe for the 2-dp regex-validated inputs but any future >2dp or exponent-format input would silently round - keep DTO regex as the single guard.
ReservationPricingService UNPRICED branch correctly omits totals (verified: no '0.00' grandTotal fabricated).

reservations.mapper.ts intentionally hides ratePlanId/rateSnapshot; verified GET /reservations/:id has no rateSnapshot key while GET /stays/:id exposes it - consumers must be documented, otherwise UI will look for it on the wrong endpoint.
seed_data_creation: Created QA rate plans (codes QACRUD*/QAAPP*/QADR*/QAPRICED*/QAOVR*/QADEF*/QAPEND*/QAROLL*/QAINACT*/QAPROBE*) with DLX applicability, a daily-rate override on 2027-04-06, and far-future reservations (2027-04-01..2027-06-03) - all created reservations were cancelled at the end of the run. NOTE two demo-data mutations made to satisfy required scenarios: (1) any pre-existing rate-plan applicability rows for room type STE were deleted so the UNPRICED case could be exercised; (2) the property's existing default rate plan was demoted (isDefault=false) before creating the QADEF default plan, so the current property default is now a QA-created plan. Re-run bootstrap:demo if pristine demo rates are needed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable suite: /app/backend/tests/test_rate_plans_snapshot_1cb.py (idempotent - unique time-based plan codes, demotes existing default plan, strips STE applicability, cancels its reservations in test_zz_cleanup). Snapshot night entries use keys date/source/roomRate/extraAdultCharge/childCharge/nightTotal (NOT stayDate/amount). rateSnapshot.policies is an OBJECT keyed by policyType with {policy, source, isActive}. Login returns HTTP 201. Demo property has no guest-pricing policy so child totals resolve to 0.00. Do not re-run inventory/concurrency suites (see iteration_11).
rca_of_the_issue: No product defects found. Two test-side corrections were needed: (a) login returns 201 not 200; (b) night entries key on 'date'/'roomRate'. The child-charge 0.00 observation roots in rate-resolver.service.ts delegating all child pricing to ChildPricingService (property age bands), bypassing the rate-plan extraChildCharge column; with no property guest-pricing policy seeded, resolveChildPricing returns total 0.
